task: Compare the prices and flight durations for economy class flights from Oslo to Dubai, departing on July 8, 2027, and show the options with no more than two layovers.
answer:
FINAL: For Oslo–Dubai on July 8, 2027, the lowest displayed fare to Dubai International (DXB) is NOK 3,160 for 27 hr 40 min with Ryanair UK + Pegasus and two layovers. Emirates is fastest at NOK 5,959 for 6 hr 50 min nonstop. Qatar Airways offers 9 hr 20 min for NOK 4,402 with one layover in Doha.

One-way economy, one adult, departing Oslo Gardermoen (OSL), with “2 stops or fewer” applied. All prices are Norwegian kroner per adult and include required taxes and fees. Durations include layovers. No return date was supplied, so this comparison uses one-way fares.

Qatar costs NOK 1,242 more than the lowest DXB fare and saves 18 hr 20 min. Emirates costs NOK 1,557 more than Qatar and saves another 2 hr 30 min.

Google’s Dubai city search also includes Sharjah International (SHJ). The lowest SHJ fare is NOK 2,945 for 29 hr 35 min with Wizz Air + Pegasus. Norwegian + AJet + Pegasus costs NOK 3,056 for 15 hr, saving 14 hr 35 min for NOK 111 more. Norwegian + Pegasus also offers NOK 3,470 for 16 hr 35 min via Munich and Istanbul SAW, and NOK 3,691 for 14 hr 35 min via Vienna and Istanbul SAW.
